tools.description: Search the Backstage catalog. `query` with `=` is a Backstage filter, comma-separated fields that must all match (kind=component,spec.type=service; kind=component,spec.owner=group:default/<team>; kind=system); without `=` it is a full-text search of entity names, titles and descriptions. Apps and services are kind=component
tools.name: catalog.read

tools.description: Run a read-only PromQL query
tools.name: metrics.query

tools.description: Run a read-only LogQL query
tools.name: logs.query

tools.description: Read an Argo CD Application: `app` is its name (an environment's is <app>-<env>, e.g. flight-api-dev) or an app's catalog component name (flight-api), which lists that app's Applications to read by name

tools.description: GET a path on an allowlisted application API
tools.name: app.api.get

tools.description: Receive pending messages from the human in this session

tools.description: Send a message to the human in this session

tools.description: Read a file, or list a directory (path empty: the repo root), in an allowed repo at a ref (default main)

tools.description: Open a PR on an app repo
tools.name: repo.pr.open

tools.description: Sync a lower-environment application
tools.name: argo.sync.lower

tools.description: Close one of this session's own runs

tools.description: Ask a person a question (non-blocking: returns its id at once)
tools.name: human.request

tools.description: Read one of this task's human requests: pending, answered (with the answer) or expired
tools.name: human.request.get

tools.description: Open a PR against an upper environment (a human merges)
tools.name: repo.pr.open_upper

tools.description: List an app's CI/CD runs, newest first (sinceHours, limit optional)
tools.name: glidepath.runs.list

tools.description: Read one run: its PipelineRun and TaskRuns
tools.name: glidepath.run.get

tools.description: Read one TaskRun's archived step logs
tools.name: glidepath.logs.get

tools.description: Why a run failed: a knownFailures id, its hint and the cicd.yaml field to change
tools.name: glidepath.explain

tools.description: Read an app's release records, or one by chainId
tools.name: glidepath.releases.get

tools.description: Re-run a PipelineRun (a copy of its spec); retrying the same call starts no second run
tools.name: glidepath.run.rerun

tools.description: Cancel a running PipelineRun (its finally tasks still run)
tools.name: glidepath.run.cancel

tools.description: Glidepath's contract: cicd.yaml fields and agent scope, gates, states, knownFailures
tools.name: glidepath.contract

tools.description: An app's PipelineRuns in the cluster now (running, and finished within the hour), each with its TaskRuns and their step containers
tools.name: glidepath.live.list

tools.description: Follow one live PipelineRun until it finishes or timeoutSeconds (1-120, default 60) passes; returns its state then and every task change seen
tools.name: glidepath.live.watch

tools.description: Read a running TaskRun's step log (container: step-<name>, from glidepath.live.list)
tools.name: glidepath.live.logs.get

tools.description: Where a promote or rollback release run is: its tasks, the PR it opened and the change request (name: the pipelineRun promote or rollback returned)
tools.name: glidepath.releaseRun.get

tools.description: An app image's supply-chain evidence: its attestations (build provenance, SBOM, scans, promotion) and whether each verifies (image: ghcr.io/<owner>/<app>...)
tools.name: glidepath.evidence.get

tools.description: An app's Testkube test runs, newest first (limit 1-200 optional)
tools.name: glidepath.tests.list

tools.description: One test run's JUnit report (id from glidepath.tests.list)
tools.name: glidepath.tests.report

tools.description: An app's recent CDEvents, oldest first (type: a CDEvent type prefix; since: an event id or RFC 3339 time; limit optional)
tools.name: glidepath.events.recent

tools.description: An app's preview environments, one per PR labelled preview: the PR, image, Argo CD sync and health, and the port-forward that reaches it
tools.name: glidepath.previews.list

tools.description: An app's release plan: its environments in promotion order, Ground (lower) and Flight (upper, with cluster)
tools.name: glidepath.environments.list

tools.description: A Flight environment's current release and the earlier healthy releases it may roll back to (newest first)
tools.name: glidepath.environments.rollbackPlan

tools.description: Propose promoting to the next Flight environment: starts the release run that opens the gitops PR a human merges (sourceEnv+sourceCluster, or sourceImageRepo+sourceImageTag for a first deploy; dryRun checks everything and starts nothing); retrying the same call starts no second run
tools.name: glidepath.promote

tools.description: Propose rolling a Flight environment back to one of its rollback plan's targets: starts the rollback release run whose PR a human merges (dryRun starts nothing); retrying the same call starts no second run
tools.name: glidepath.rollback

tools.description: What a cicd.yaml change (a JSON merge patch) would mean for an app: valid or not, each finding with its rule and fix, every field it touches with its scope, the resulting file (baseRef optional)
tools.name: glidepath.cicd.validate

tools.description: Propose a cicd.yaml change: validated by glidepath-api as an agent's change and refused with the GP rule when invalid, else opened as a pull request on the app's repo (repo: owner/<app>) that a human merges; title required, body and branch optional. A change the contract's `propose` class allows, such as a new Flight environment, is marked for a person to merge: the PR carries a `Hangar-Merge: person` trailer and the receipt says so
tools.name: glidepath.cicd.propose

tools.description: What Airframe offers: chart fields, XR kinds, components and their outputs, conditions and verify checks (kind or section optional). Call it with section `appspec` BEFORE writing an AppSpec: every field, how config (chart values for every environment) and overrides (per environment) map onto chart values, and a worked example. A large answer is clipped: narrow with section or kind
tools.name: airframe.capabilities

tools.description: Validate proposed env-file or values content with airframe-validate: AF-* rule ids, JSON paths and fix hints (documents: [{path, content}])
tools.name: airframe.validate

tools.description: What an AF-* rule id, a condition reason or a knownFailures id means, and how to fix it
tools.name: airframe.explain

tools.description: Plan an AppSpec into an ordered change set (pass baseCicd, the app's current cicd.yaml). The spec's shape (fields, `config` chart values for every environment, `overrides` per environment) is airframe.capabilities {section: appspec}: read it once instead of guessing
tools.name: airframe.plan

tools.description: An app's (or one environment's) XR conditions: reason, hint, stale-status detection
tools.name: airframe.status

tools.description: One environment: its XRs, the Argo CD Application syncing it and its Rollout
tools.name: airframe.describe

tools.description: Run an XR's sidecar verify checks from its status alone; anything needing a Secret, port-forward or exec is skipped with the reason
tools.name: airframe.verify

tools.description: Apply an AppSpec: opens the next step of airframe.plan's change set as a pull request for a person to merge (one PR per call; call again with the same spec after each merge, or after an interruption: it resumes). Steps: the tenants repo, the app's repo, and with `proposeFlight: true` (only for a definition that sets profile.airframe.proposeFlight) the Flight half too: the Flight environments and release step in cicd.yaml and the Flight values in gitops-<app>, each marked for a person to merge (`awaiting-merge`, never merged by the tool or an agent). Without proposeFlight the Flight half is reported in humanSteps for a person
tools.name: airframe.apply
